dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I'm Harry of the Knights of Favonius. This area has been deemed highly dangerous, and I have been ordered to keep the public away.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Vicious monsters have been reported around the Stormbearer Mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: We have yet to ascertain their precise location, but the Knights of Favonius are on their trail.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't see any other knights here except you...

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: We need to confirm the monsters' positions before taking large-scale action. Otherwise, they'll see us coming and run off.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Hence, the search team is operating in smaller units. They are operating very discreetly and staying away from the public eye.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Please, for your safety, stay away from the Stormbearer Mountains.
